topic.source_contract: development quantum, trip generation, mode split, network baseline, safety and capacity assessment, mitigation, travel-plan obligations, implementation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A trip-rate estimate is not treated as observed site traffic.
A transport assessment is not treated as highway approval.
A travel-plan target is not treated as achieved mode shift.
A mitigation drawing is not treated as constructed highway works.
A planning obligation is not treated as paid or delivered infrastructure.
A bus service proposal is not treated as an operating service.
A monitoring framework is not treated as monitored performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact demand, network, approvals, delivery and monitored travel outcomes.
